arguments.command:
python3 -c "
# February 1938 expenditures
feb_1938 = 528
# January 1939 expenditures
jan_1939 = 693

# Calculate absolute percent difference using midpoint formula
# |A - B| / ((A + B) / 2) * 100
diff = abs(feb_1938 - jan_1939)
midpoint = (feb_1938 + jan_1939) / 2
percent_diff = (diff / midpoint) * 100

print(f'February 1938 expenditures: {feb_1938}')
print(f'January 1939 expenditures: {jan_1939}')
print(f'Absolute difference: {diff}')
print(f'Midpoint: {midpoint}')
print(f'Absolute percent difference: {percent_diff}')
print(f'Rounded to nearest tenths: {round(percent_diff, 1)}')
"
